# Wall St roars back as oil slide eases inflation jitters

Published November 10, 2026 Updated November 10, 2026 04:44am

By Reuters

NEW YORK: Wall Street’s main indexes rebounded on Monday as a drop in oil prices soothed investor nerves after last week’s selloff, even as AI heavyweight Nvidia hit a seven-month low following the controversy surrounding CEO Jensen Huang.

The strong gains allayed concerns about the AI trade, which shook markets following the Democrats’ midterm triumph last week. Ten of 11 major S&P 500 sector indexes were in positive territory, with industrials and consumer discretionary leading gains.

US President Donald Trump downplayed the likelihood of renewed strikes on Iran, sending crude prices lower and easing inflation concerns.

Inflation will be front and center this week after the Labor Department releases its Consumer Price Index report for October on Tuesday.

Markets also drew comfort from some Wall Street brokerages calling for calm. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
